name: Industrial Spill Response
description: A factory upstream has discharged toxic waste into the sewer. Protect your biological process.

introMessage.title: Emergency: Industrial Discharge Detected!
introMessage.text:
The pH and toxicity monitors at the headworks are spiking! A local manufacturer has accidentally discharged a large volume of chemical waste. Your operators report a strong solvent odor.

The slug is estimated to arrive at the aeration basins within 30 minutes. Your biological process is at risk of being killed.

objectives.description: Keep aeration MLSS above 1500 mg/L through the event
objectives.hint: The toxic slug may kill biomass. Consider reducing feed to the aeration basin.

objectives.description: Achieve effluent NH3 below 5 mg/L after the spill
objectives.hint: Nitrifiers are especially sensitive to toxins. Recovery may take days.
Some violations may be unavoidable. Focus on quick recovery.

objectives.description: Collect 3 lab samples during the event
objectives.hint: Documentation is critical for regulatory response. Sample influent, effluent, and aeration.

action.title: Toxic Slug Arriving!
action.text: The toxic discharge is entering the aeration basins now. DO consumption will spike and biomass may be damaged. Consider emergency measures.

action.title: Spill Subsiding
action.text: The worst of the industrial discharge has passed. Now focus on recovery — rebuild your biomass and restore nitrification.
